possibleMatch.description: 2.001 Indicates if the arragnement relates to a possible or definite match

pensionReference.description:
2.003 The reference to identify a users pension and assist when the user contacts the pension provider/scheme.


This may or may not be the policy number.

pensionType.description:
2.010
Explanations:
  * `AVC` - additional voluntary contribution
  * `CB` - cash balance
  * `CDC` - collective defined contribution
  * `DB` - defined benefit
  * `DC` - defined contribution
  * `HYB` - Hybrid benefit is a benefit that depends on two or more alternative methods of calculation to produce the highest, or lowest, rate or amount (it can include an underpin).
  * `SP` - state pension

pensionOrigin.description:
2.011 Won't be available if match type is possible or the arrangement is a state pension

- `A`	deferred annuity 
- `PC`	pension provider  - pension credit user 
- `PM`	pension provider– active or deferred user 
- `PT`	pension provider – deferred transfer in user  
- `WC`	scheme - pension credit user 
- `WM`	scheme – active or deferred user 
- `WT`	scheme – deferred transfer in user

pensionStatus.description:
2.012 Won't be available if match type is possible or the arrangement is a state pension
- `A`	active
- `I`	inactive
- `IPPF`	inactive and the scheme is subject to a Pensions Protection Fund (PPF) assessment period 
- `IWU` 	inactive and the pension provider/   scheme is winding up

retirementDate.description:
2.014 The retirement date that was used to calculate the user’s benefits.

Won't be available if match type is possible or the arrangement is a state pension

pensionStartDate.description: 2.013 The start date of the pension

statePensionDate.description: 2.017 The date the user will reach the age that State Pension may be claimed

dateOfBirth.description:
2.016 Date of birth of the pension owner. Must be a valid date, not in the future (a valid month, a number of days that is valid for the month, inclusion of 29 February if a leap year).

Won't be available if match type is possible or the arrangement is a state pension

statePensionMessageEng.description:
2.018
State Pension Message in English

Must be provided for state pension

Must not be provided for any other pension type
examples: I am a message in English

statePensionMessageWelsh.description:
2.019
State Pension Message in Welsh

Must be provided for state pension

Must not be provided for any other pension type

contributionsFromMultipleEmployers.description: 2.023 Indicates if multiple employers have contributed to the pension.

pensionAdministrator.description:
Details of the pension administrator.

These only contain the administrator name and how to contact them.

A single set of pension administrator details must be provided for each arrangement.

employmentMembershipPeriods.description:
A list detailing period of contributions toward the arrangement from employers.
 If provided, the list may not contain all the contribution membership periods.

benefitIllustrations.description:
Illustrations for benefits payable under the arrangement.

An arrangement may have multiple illustrations where benefits of different types are payable and/or where benefits are payable on different dates.

additionalDataSources.description: Links to web pages that contain additional information related to the pension arrangement

administrativeDetailsNotAvailable.description: 2.005 To explain to the new member user that not all administrative details will be available for up to 3 months after they have joined the scheme.

contactScheme.description: 2.004 Code to indicate there has been a match but the user should contact the pension provider before it provides any (or all) the user’s pensions information.

temporarySystemError.description: 2.006 To explain to the user that some or all of the pensions information is not available due to a temporary system error and they should re-try shortly.

name.description: 2.008 An alternate pension provider/scheme by which the pension may be known to the Pension Owner
examples: Converted from MyOld Direct Contribution Scheme

alternateNameType.description:
2.009 The explanation for the alternative name
Explanations:
 * `FOR` - This was the former name of the pension provider/scheme
 * `OTH` - This was the name of a different pension provider/scheme where most (or all) of the user benefits accrued before they were transferred into the pension/provider scheme.

name.description: 2.101 The name of the organisation that administers the pension

contactMethods.description: A list of the methods by which the administrator may be contacted by the pension owner or delegate.

preferred.description: 2.103, 2.105, 2.108, 2.117 (Stanards Reference Depends on Contact Method Type).   Identifies if the asscocated contact method details are one of the preferred contact methods for the administrator in relatiion to this arrangement.

contactMethodDetails.description: The details of an actual way by which the administrator may be contacted.

number.description: 2.106 The actual phone number including the international dialling code.

usage.description:
2.107
 - `A`	WhatsApp contact number
- `M`	main
- `N`	non-UK number
- `S`	SMS
- `W`	Welsh speaking

postalAddress.title: postalAddress
postalAddress.description:
The data provided in the postal address must comply to a valid postal address for the country of the address.

The postal address must equate to a valid postal address for the address country if the data (where provided) is ordered as follows:
- postalName
- line1
- line2
- line3
- line4
- line5
- postcode
- countryCode

postalName.description: 2.109 The addressee to be used in the postal address

line1.description: 2.110 The initial line of the address

line2.description: 2.111 Only use if line 1 is populated

line3.description: 2.112 Only use if line 2 is populated

line4.description: 2.113 Only use if line 3 is populated

line5.description: 2.114 Only use if line 4 is populated

countryCode.description:
2.115 The country code of address given by the administrator.
As a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

url.description: 2.102 The URL to allow the user access to pensions administrator website to get information on the arrangement

employmentMembershipPeriod.title: employmentMembershipPeriod
employmentMembershipPeriod.description: Details of periods of contributions toward the arrangement from employers.

employmentStartDate.description: 2.204 The start date of the pension owners membership period under the employer.

employmentEndDate.description: 2.205 The end date of the pension owners membership period under the employer.

benefitIllustration.title: benefitIllustration
benefitIllustration.description: Details of an illustrations related to a particular benefit payable at a particular time under the arrangement.

illustrationComponents.description:
The components of the illustration

There must be at least one component in and illustration.

illustrationDate.description: 2.501 The ‘as at’ date the values were calculated, shows how current the values are.

eri.title: eri
eri.description: An ERI illustration for to a particular benefit payable at a particular time under the arrangement.

unavailableReason.description:
2.301 Provided if some of the illustration data is not available.

Values can idicate that the data will never be available, that the data may become available at an undefined date in the future or that the data should be available within a prescribed time period

- `ANO` 	benefits cannot currently be provided as information is required from a third party (for example, a final leaving salary from the employer for a DB benefit)
- `DB` 	DB or cash balance benefit ERI not required to be provided (deferred member ) and will not be providing it  
- `DBC`	DB or cash balance benefit being calculated and will be available within 10 working days  (from the day after the day the PeI is registered as a match)
- `DCC` 	DC benefit is benefit being calculated and will be available within 3 working days (from the day after the day the PeI is registered as a match)
- `DCHA`	DC/Hybrid benefit: the value of the pot is less than £5,000, no contributions are being made to the pension provider/scheme and they have notified the user they will not be providing any further Statutory Money Purchase Illustrations (SMPIs) until contributions restart
- `DCHP`	DC/Hybrid benefit and the user is within 2 years of their retirement date or older
- `MEM`	benefits cannot currently be provided because there is an action or decision outstanding from the user 
- `NEW` 	user is a new member user of the pension provider/scheme and ERI value data is not yet available
- `NET` user is a new member user of the pension provider/schemes as a result of a transfer in and accrued pension information is not yet available
- `PPF` the scheme is subject to a PPF assessment period and the user should contact the scheme administrator
- `TRN`	transaction outstanding that affects the value
- `WU`	the pension provider/scheme is in the process of winding up and the user should contact the administrator

benefitType.description:
2.302 The type of benefit that the illustration is for.

- `AVC`	additional voluntary contribution
- `CBL`	cash balance benefit expressed as a lump sum
- `CBS`	cash balance benefit
- `CDI`	collective DC benefits expressed as regular income
- `CDL`	collective DC benefits expressed as a lump sum
- `DB`	defined benefit
- `DBL`	defined benefit separately accrued lump sum (NOT commutation)
- `DC`	defined contribution

calculationMethod.description:
2.304 The method used to calculate the illustration.

- `BS`	benefit-specific method based on pension provider/scheme rules
- `CBI`	cash balance illustration methodology from ASTM1 for calculating income fund only and/or benefit-specific method based on pension provider
- `SMPI`	statutory money purchase illustration methodology from ASTM1

payableDetails.description:
Details of the amount payable or the reason that the amount will not be provided.
Must be provided unless an unavailableReason has been provided.

estimatedDcPot.description: 2.310 The estimated retirement pot used to calculate the benefit

survivorBenefit.description: 2.312 An indicator that the benefit value shown also has survivors’ benefits

safeguardedBenefit.description: 2.313 An indicator that the benefit value shown also has safeguarded benefits

illustrationWarnings.description:
2.314 Warnings may be provided to explain important additional information to the user which will affect the value of the benefit or the value show
Warnings may be temporary or permanent.
There is no guarantee that all relevant warnings will be provided.

oneOf.description: Details of a calculated recurring income
Details of a calculated one off lump sum payment

- `INCL`	recurring income alternative calculated using the LEGACY pension provider/scheme basis

monthlyAmount.description: 2.307 (Eri), 2.407 (Accrued) The monthly amount payable, in GBP,  this will represent an amount paid monthly for the payable term of the benefit.
